dogecoin.text: Fast forward to 2021—what actually happened? Dogecoin and Shiba Inu, two joke coins, rocketed to the moon. NFTs—literal jpegs—sold for millions. Ponzi-style yield farms like Olympus DAO sucked in billions. Meanwhile, the “smart” bets—
Look at Dogecoin: a meme, a Shiba Inu, and boom, it’s on Sunday Morning News while girls at the nail salon gossip about it. That’s the Peanut Brain Theory in action.
By studying coins like Cardano, Bitcoin, and Dogecoin, we’ll uncover why euphoria isn’t guaranteed and how to stay sharp when the market tempts you to let your guard down.
